title: BookPrinter
description: BookPrinter — A modern lightweight book generation plugin
body:
# BookPrinter 📖

BookPrinter is a high-performance plugin optimized for **Paper/Folia** servers, designed to quickly convert `.txt` files into in-game written books. It utilizes asynchronous NIO.2 file processing to ensure no main-thread lag and includes multiple layers of path security checks to prevent unauthorized access.

---
**[See detailed information](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/bookprinter.133453/)**

## ✨ Key Features

- **Dual Parsing Modes**  
  The recommended **Modern Mode** supports RGB gradients, Hex colors, and all modern text formatting via MiniMessage, while maintaining backward compatibility with traditional `&` color codes. **Classic Mode** offers various page-splitting strategies for older server versions.

- **Flexible Payment Options**  
  Supports payments via money (Vault) or experience (levels/points), easily configurable.

- **Built-in Multi-language Support**  
  Comes with Chinese and English language files, with the ability to add custom languages.

- **Convenient Commands**  
  `/bp info/print/reload/gui/buy.

- **Automatic Title Formatting**  
  Intelligently converts filenames into book titles (e.g., `my_story.txt` → `My Story`).

Simply place your text files into the plugin's data folder to generate richly formatted books in-game—an ideal tool for announcements, quests, or publishing stories.
